source: export.monster.Monster20.initBBDC()+setAction() in 打开我开始玩.swf; sheet 3.swf chid8 Monster20. 袁洪 (Yuan Hong). Branch: `gc.curStage==3 && gc.curLevel==3 || gc.curStage==8` -> hp 30000 (the level-3 branch used here); else-branch hp 33000 is a different level's tuning, not used. Both branches set isBoss=true, so this species always self-identifies as a boss, but level3.ts folds it into a grunt-wave heavy (scene-2 stop point) rather than the arena boss slot, matching the roster in StageListener32. "dead" row is isBoss-conditional in source (row 3 when isBoss, row 6 for the non-boss `fenshen()` split-body clone spawned by hit2's scriptFrameOverFunc) — row 3 (the isBoss=true path, matching how this species is always constructed) is recorded here; the clone/fenshen split-body mechanic itself is not modeled (no direct HP/stat implication, purely a combat-script behavior). Row 5 (hit2) has setFrameCount=24 vs actual stopCounts length 2 — recorded frameCount faithfully per playbook pitfall #5, sheet+stopCounts (2 frames) are authoritative for the render grid.
